mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing a warm 83 degrees with a heat index of 87 and clear skies near the Verona Area High School, with the moon currently in its third quarter phase.

The city has a couple of great updates today. The Verona Senior Center is launching a new free tri-shaw bike program for residents to enjoy the outdoors, and the Recreation Department is currently hiring for various seasonal positions including adult fitness instructors.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Hop Haus Trivia and Wisconsin Brewing Company trivia today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia fun at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a driver being arrested for an O W I and cited for suspended vehicle registration.
It is a great day to grab a scoop of our flavor of the day, Butter Pecan. The store is open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to stop in and satisfy that sweet tooth.
